title: Gamorrean Guards
description: GAMORREAN GUARDS changed from monkey to pig when Joe Johnston (front) drew them as upright wild boars. The final look (back) was designed by Dave Carson of Industrial Light & Magic's Monster Shop. The pig-guards were going to be bare-chested and dressed In skimpy gladiator-like clothes. But they ended up wearing a Killer cloth and leather uniform with metal epaulets to cover the seams of the molded rubber costume.
